checkedUsing: Official publisher pages and public endpoints; retrieval/access status is recorded separately from suitability.
sourceReleaseVersion: Each publisher's release is recorded independently; this is not a reader contract version.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: LAUS 2025 NSA monthly and annual-average series
reviews.observationPeriod: 2025 monthly M01-M12 plus official annual M13 when returned
reviews.status: Keyed v2 collection is pending secure environment injection. Prior public sampling confirmed 2025 M10 is explicitly missing and that M13 availability varies by series; the collector records both as source status and never derives M13.
limitations: Registered BLS API v2 uses the injected BLS_API_KEY; the worker does not read credential files.
If run without the key, the collector caps itself at 20 requests/day and records pending work.
M13 is a distinct annual average observation when published; absent M13 is not derived from monthly values.
October 2025 is unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations; keep it missing, not zero.

reviews.status: 2025 CIUS annual release verified August 14, 2026; local monthly CDE data are complete, but the state-by-offense annual estimate table is not captured. Annual readiness remains unresolved.
limitations: The FBI reports 2025 program data from 17,075 agencies covering 96.2% of inhabitants; participation and estimation coverage vary by state/offense.
Monthly CDE series are not annual CIUS estimates; do not sum rates or admit monthly completeness as annual values.
FBI annual rates use the source estimate/reporting population and are not recalculated against Census 2024 population.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: Electric Power Annual with data for 2025
reviews.status: 2025 Electric Power Annual release confirmed and ALL-sector values prepared for 51 states; baseline 2024 ALL-sector comparison/ranks generated.
limitations: Average retail price is cents per kWh, not an exclusively residential tariff or a monthly charge.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: Vintage 2025 county and national population estimates
reviews.observationPeriod: July 1 annual population estimates, including revised 2023 and 2024 values
reviews.status: Vintage 2025 source downloads verified; 2023/2024 total, under-18, and age-13+ denominators prepared for 3,144 county geographies and state/nation.
limitations: A newer vintage revises the full time series; do not mix vintages in one denominator series.
Under-18 totals are the sum of Census single ages 0 through 17, not the 0-19 age group.

reviews.status: Latest county-wide ACS release reviewed; this package preserves the existing 2020-2024 share denominators and does not refresh ACS data.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

reviews.observationPeriod: The obesity, diabetes, and physical inactivity estimates are based on 2023 BRFSS
reviews.status: December 2025 release and 2023 BRFSS period reviewed; no PLACES data extraction is included in this package.
limitations: For 2023-BRFSS measures, county estimates for Kentucky and Pennsylvania are unavailable.
The release uses ACS 2019-2023 geography/covariate data and Census 2023 county population estimates; the PLACES period is annual/model-based, not an ACS five-year period.

reviews.status: current suitable release; next release is scheduled for 2026-12-10
limitations: RPP is a state/metro price-level index with U.S.=100; it does not provide county values.

reviews.status: Tax year 2023 county release verified; 3,143 counties and eight A00100 AGI bands per county parsed; thousand-USD conversion and matched-year 2023 population rates prepared.
limitations: A00100 is in thousands of dollars; multiply by 1,000 for USD.
Exclude county FIPS 000 state totals when summing county records.
Per-resident income uses matching-year July 1 population estimates, not tax returns or ACS per-capita income.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: 2026 U.S. Cancer Statistics submission; 2023 incidence is the latest incidence year
reviews.observationPeriod: New cancer cases diagnosed through 2023; cancer deaths through 2024
reviews.status: 2023 incidence is latest; retained published state/DC count observations copied by hash and crude 2023-count/2024-PEP rate review prepared. Original publisher download was blocked in this shell environment.
limitations: Keep crude rates distinct from age-adjusted rates.
Retained normalized USCS observations document numeric displayed rows under the source suppression selector; do not infer unavailable rows. The current fresh publisher download returned HTTP 403.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: CDC HIV Diagnoses, Deaths, and Prevalence 2024
reviews.observationPeriod: 2024; diagnosis tables report age 13 and older
reviews.status: 2024 is latest; retained 51-state provisional age-13+ diagnosis counts reused and rates recalculated with 2024 PEP age-13+ denominators. Fresh publisher XLSX request returned HTTP 403.
limitations: Numbers under 12 and rates based on them require caution.
The retained count is provisional 2024 diagnoses age 13+ reported through December 2025 with a 12-month reporting delay.
Use the PEP age-13+ denominator; the fresh publisher table endpoint returned HTTP 403.

reviews.latestSuitableRelease: CDC WONDER Multiple Cause of Death final file 2024
reviews.status: 2024 final release confirmed; retained 51-state under-18 count observations reused and crude rates prepared with 2024 PEP under-18 denominators; suppressed counts of 9 or fewer remain unavailable.
limitations: 2025 and later are provisional; do not replace the 2024 final metric automatically.
Use age 0-17 deaths over July 1, 2024 population age 0-17.
Suppressed cells remain missing; no zeros are fabricated.
